title: Sahara: web3 analytics for humans
tagline: Sahara: know everything about your product using human language
description: If you are a web3 founder or analyst, you need to track important metrics of your product and competitors. That's can be vital for your business! But you need to spend time learning SQL to be able to do that. Sahara allows you to get answers to your questions simply by typing them in a text field.
how_its_made: We use large language models to transform a user's query into an SQL request or to find an existing chart on Dune. We also leverage the Dune API to run SQL queries and get blockchain data. The AI engine was provided with data about Lens, Uniswap, ENS, and other protocols. So, web3 founders can easily track metrics of their products if they use these protocols.
